title: 13 Years Later, Crunchyroll’s Acclaimed Fantasy Unveils New Movie Trailer After Major Delay
content: Crunchyroll is the largest global streaming platform for anime fans, home to countless beloved shows and films. One of them is the award-winning dark fantasy Puella Magi Madoka Magica . The series centers around magical girls and remains one of the most shocking anime of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: Koei Tecmo Develops Tentatively Titled 'Fuji' Game Project
content: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) revealed through its IP360 project on Friday Koei Tecmo 's new temporarily titled "Fuji" game project. The listing describes the project as an "action game" with "oriental" visuals.
author: ANN

title: 27 Years Later, Major Shonen Jump Creator Confirms Work on Grand Finale
content: 27 years after it first made its debut in the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, a major creator has confirmed that they are now working on the final chapter of the franchise with the intent of releasing it very soon.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2' Unveils Additional Staff, Second Teaser Promo
content: Netflix Japan revealed additional staff members and a second teaser promotional video for the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime on Tuesday. The 10-episode anime series is scheduled to premiere worldwide on Netflix in Fall 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Demon Slayer: The Hinokami Chronicles 2 Game Gets Switch 2 Edition on October 29
content: Players who own the physical or digital Nintendo Switch version can upgrade to the Switch 2 version for free. However, this method will not come with the separately sold "Infinity Castle" Character Pass of seven DLC characters.
author: ANN

title: 'Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru II' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website of the Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru ( From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman ) anime series revealed additional cast and an action promotional video for the second season on Monday.

title: MARRIAGETOXIN Episode 13 (Finale) Preview Revealed
content: MARRIAGETOXIN anime revealed the preview and synopsis for Episode 13 (Season 1 finale) ahead of the episode’s June 30 release. Studio BONES Film is handling the animation production, which premiered on April 3 . Crunchyroll is streaming the anime.

title: Evangelion: Death (True)² & Rebirth, The End Of Evangelion Films Hit U.S. Theaters for 30th Anniversary Movie Fest on July 21-22
content: GKIDS announced on Thursday that it will host the EVANGELION 30th Movie Fest and screen the films Neon Genesis Evangelion: Death & Rebirth ( Evangelion : Death (True)² & Rebirth ) and The End of Evangelion on July 21 and 22. Tickets for the film are now on sale on GKIDS ' website .
author: ANN
